candidates.summary: the realm cap truncates directly changed realms, so the comment links realms the snapshot never rendered and prints "the changed realms are always kept" while dropping one
candidates.failure_scenario: A sweep over examples/ touching 26 realms (a gnomod.toml field migration, a formatting pass; 58 realm modules exist at this head) runs with the default -max-realms=25. plan.Realms is cut to 25 and plan.Dropped=1, but plan.ChangedRealms keeps all 26, so Comment prints "**Changed realms (26)**" and links the 26th with its `source` and `help` shortcuts — three URLs that 404 on the published Pages snapshot — then closes with "1 more affected realm(s) were **not** rendered (cap reached) — the changed realms are always kept". The reviewer clicking the realm the PR is about gets a 404 and a comment telling them that cannot happen.

candidates.summary: in Mode()=="both" the four gnoweb seed realms are booted, crawled and published but appear nowhere in the comment
candidates.failure_scenario: BuildPlan appends gnowebSeedRealms whenever plan.Gnoweb (plan.go:263-270), so a PR touching gnoweb and one realm renders r/gnoland/home, r/docs/security_patterns, r/gnoland/boards2/v0 and r/gnoland/blog too.
